# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation I §§ 1–2)

## Τῇ Θ΄: Τῶν Ἁγίων Μ΄ Μαρτύρων (Περίπτωσις Α΄ §§ 1–2) [Violakis, p. 416]

### ΠΕΡΙΠΤΩΣΕΙΣ

#### Α΄.

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τῶν Μαρτύρων τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Α΄ ἑβδομάδος τῶν Νηστειῶν, τῇ Τρίτῃ πρωΐ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τῶν ἁγίων Προσόμοια Φέροντες τὰ παρόντα γενναίως γ΄. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Προσόμοιον Σταυροθεοτοκίον, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῶν Ἀποστίχων δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Σταυροθεοτοκίον, Νῦν ἀπολύεις, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Θεοτόκε Παρθένε κτλ. καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

2.    Τῇ Τετάρτῃ πρωΐ, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἀντὶ Λιτῆς λέγονται τὰ Ἰδιόμελα τῶν Αἴνων καὶ ἓν Δόξα τῶν Ἁγίων μετὰ τοῦ καταλλήλου Θεοτοκίου· εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἁγίων δὶς καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας, τὰ Καθίσματα τῶν Ἁγίων κατὰ σειράν, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Θαυμαστὸς ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τοῖς Ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τῶν Ἁγίων, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν ἀθλοφόρων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ ἰδιόμελον Προφητικῶς ἀνεβόα. Ὁ Κανὼν τῆς Θεοτόκου Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα κτλ. ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον· Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὰ Ἐξαποστειλάρια, οἱ Αἶνοι, Δόξα, Ἀθλοφόροι Χριστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν, Μακαρίζομέν σε, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ ἀναγινώσκονται αἱ Ὧραι λιταί, ἐν αἷς λέγομεν Ἀπολυτίκιον Τὰς ἀλγηδόνας τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ Κοντάκιον Πᾶσαν Στρατιάν. Εἰς τὴν Θ΄ Ὥραν ψάλλονται οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν τῇ μνήμῃ τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους ἐν περιπτώσει Η΄ § 14.

*(Printed Page 416)*

=== LEAF p432 ===

# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation I §§ 1–2)

## March 9: The Holy Forty Martyrs [in the Lake of Sebastea] (Situation I §§ 1–2) [Violakis, p. 417]

### SITUATIONS

#### SITUATION ONE

1.    If the Commemoration of the Martyrs occurs on Wednesday of the First Week of the Great Fast: on Tuesday morning, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we sing the 3 Prosomia of the cycle of the Triodion and 3 Prosomia of the Saints: **"Bravely enduring the sufferings of the present life"** (*Φέροντες τὰ παρόντα γενναίως*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": Prosomion Stavrotheotokion; "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon of the Aposticha twice, and the Martyrikon; "Glory... Both now and ever...": Stavrotheotokion; then **"Now let Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29), the Trisagion Prayers, **"Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*), etc., and Dismissal.

2.    On Wednesday morning: after Psalm 50 [LXX], instead of the Liti we chant the Idiomela of the Praises and one "Glory..." of the Saints with its appropriate Theotokion; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints, and the Hexapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints twice, and the Theotokion; then the Psalter of the day, the Kathismata of the Saints in order, the Anavathmoi (the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4), the Prokeimenon: **"Wondrous is God in His Saints"** (*Θαυμαστὸς ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τοῖς Ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ*, Ps. 67:36 LXX); then "Let every breath praise the Lord" and the Matins Gospel of the Saints; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the prize-bearers"** (*Ταῖς τῶν ἀθλοφόρων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: "Have mercy on me, O God" [Ps. 50:3 LXX] and the Idiomelon: **"David cried out prophetically in the psalms"** (*Προφητικῶς ἀνεβόα*). The Canon of the Theotokos: **"Traversing the deep water"** (*Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας*) and that of the Saints; after the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma, etc.; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, and the Menologion; Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); then we chant with verses "More honorable than the Cherubim"; the Exapostilaria, the Praises; "Glory...": **"O prize-bearers of Christ"** (*Ἀθλοφόροι Χριστοῦ*); "Both now and ever...": **"We bless thee, O Virgin"** (*Μακαρίζομέν σε*); Great Doxology, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints, and the plain Hours are read, at which we say the Dismissal Troparion: **"By reason of the sufferings which the Saints endured for Thy sake, O Lord"** (*Τὰς ἀλγηδόνας τῶν Ἁγίων*), and the Kontakion: **"Every army"** (*Πᾶσαν στρατιάν*). At the 9th Hour, the Beatitudes and the rest of the service are chanted as prescribed in the commemoration of the Holy Hieromartyr Charalampos under Situation Eight, Paragraph 14.[^275]

*(Printed Page 417)*

=== LEAF p433 ===

# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation I Concl. §§ 3–4; Dietary Note; Situation II §§ 4 bis–5)

## Τῇ Θ΄: Τῶν Ἁγίων Μ΄ Μαρτύρων (Περιπτώσεις Α΄ Τέλος §§ 3–4, Κατάλυσις, Β΄ §§ 4 δὶς–5) [Violakis, p. 418]

3.    Εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Νηστεύσαντες ἀδελφοὶ δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν· τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου Προσόμοια, καὶ δ΄ τῶν Ἁγίων. Δόξα, Ἐν ᾠδαῖς ἀσμάτων, Καὶ νῦν, Προσόμοιον, θεοτοκίον, Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων. Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

4.    Τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Α΄ καὶ Γ΄ ἑβδομάδος, ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τῆς Προηγιασμένης τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῆς ἡμέρας δίς, τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς Προσόμοια καὶ δ΄ τῶν Ἁγίων. Δόξα, τῶν Ἁγίων, Καὶ νῦν, Προσόμοιον Θεοτοκίον κτλ. ὡς ἀνωτέρω.

    Ἐν οἱᾳδήποτε ἡμέρᾳ τῆς Α΄ ἑβδομάδος καὶ ἂν τύχῃ ἡ ἑορτή, γίνεται κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου.

### Β΄.

4. (δίς).    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Πέμπτῃ τῆς αὐτῆς ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Τετάρτῃ πρωῒ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῆς ἡμέρας δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου Προσόμοια καὶ δ΄ τῶν Ἁγίων. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Θεοτοκίον Προσόμοιον. Εἴσοδος μετὰ θυμιατοῦ, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν Γεύσασθε καὶ ἴδετε, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

5.    Τῇ Πέμπτῃ πρωΐ, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου μέχρι τῆς Δοξολογίας, αἱ Ὧραι καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ ψάλλονται κατὰ τὴν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2, 3 διάταξιν. Ἐν δὲ τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὸ τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ἰδιόμελον Οἱ ποθοῦντες τοῦ θείου Πάσχα μετασχεῖν δίς, τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια, καὶ τὰ τῶν Ἁγίων Φέροντες τὰ παρόντα δ΄. Δόξα, Ἐν ᾠδαῖς ἀσμάτων, Καὶ νῦν, Προσόμοιον Σταυροθεοτοκίον, Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας· τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation I Concl. §§ 3–4; Dietary Note; Situation II §§ 4 bis–5)

## March 9: The Holy Forty Martyrs [in the Lake of Sebastea] (Situation I Concl. §§ 3–4, Dietary Note, Situation II §§ 4 bis–5) [Violakis, p. 419]

3.    At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we sing the Idiomelon: **"Having fasted, brethren"** (*Νηστεύσαντες ἀδελφοὶ*) twice, and the Martyrikon; the 3 Prosomia of the cycle of the Triodion, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": **"In songs and hymns let us praise"** (*Ἐν ᾠδαῖς ἀσμάτων*); "Both now and ever...": Prosomion Theotokion; Little Entrance with the Holy Gospel Book, "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX], the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints, and then the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows; Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

4.    On Wednesday of the First and Third Week, at Vespers of the Presanctified, we chant the Idiomelon of the day twice, the Martyrikon once, the 3 Prosomia of the sequence, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": Prosomion Theotokion, etc., as above.

    On whatever day of the First Week the Feast occurs, the consumption of wine and oil is permitted.

### SITUATION TWO

4. (dup.)    If the Feast occurs on Thursday of this week: on Wednesday morning at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", the Idiomelon of the day twice, and the Martyrikon, the 3 Prosomia of the Triodion of the sequence, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory... Both now and ever...": Prosomion Theotokion; Little Entrance with the censer, "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX], and the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows; Communion Verse: **"O taste and see"** (*Γεύσασθε καὶ ἴδετε*, Ps. 33:9 LXX); **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

5.    On Thursday morning: the service of Matins until the Doxology, and the Hours and the rest are sung according to the order of Situation One, Paragraphs 2 and 3. At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we sing the Idiomelon from the Aposticha: **"Those who desire to share in the divine Pascha"** (*Οἱ ποθοῦντες τοῦ θείου Πάσχα μετασχεῖν*) twice, the Martyrikon, the 3 Prosomia [of the Triodion], and those of the Saints: **"Bravely enduring the sufferings of the present life"** (*Φέροντες τὰ παρόντα γενναίως*) in 4 by repeating the first; "Glory...": **"In songs and hymns let us praise"** (*Ἐν ᾠδαῖς ἀσμάτων*); "Both now and ever...": Prosomion Stavrotheotokion; Little Entrance with the Holy Gospel Book, "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX], the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints, and then the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows; Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

    On Thursday of the Second and Third Week, the Idiomelon of the Aposticha of the day is chanted twice, the Martyrikon once, the 3 Prosomia of the sequence, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": Prosomion Stavrotheotokion, etc., as above.[^276]

# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation II Concl.; Situation III § 6; Situation IV § 7)

## Τῇ Θ΄: Τῶν Ἁγίων Μ΄ Μαρτύρων (Περιπτώσεις Β΄ Τέλος, Γ΄ § 6, Δ΄ § 7) [Violakis, p. 420]

Ἀποστίχων τῆς ἡμέρας δίς, τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς Προσόμοια, καὶ δ΄ τῶν Ἁγίων. Δόξα, τῶν Ἁγίων, Καὶ νῦν, Προσόμοιον Σταυροθεοτοκίον κτλ. ὡς ἀνωτέρω.

### Γ΄.

6.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Παρασκευῇ τῆς αὐτῆς ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Πέμπτῃ πρωῒ ὁ Ἑσπερινὸς ψάλλεται, ὡς προδιετυπώθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 1. Τῇ δὲ Παρασκευῇ πρωῒ ὁ Ὄρθρος μέχρι τῆς Δοξολογίας, καὶ αἱ Ὧραι ψάλλονται, ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2. Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Δεῦτε πιστοὶ δίς, δ΄ Προσόμοια τῶν μαρτύρων, καὶ δ΄ τοῦ ἁγίου Θεοδώρου. Δόξα, Ἐν ᾠδαῖς ἀσμάτων, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ τυχόντος ἤχου. Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας· τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, εἶτα Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων. Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀναγινώσκονται οἱ Οἶκοι τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὡς εἴθισται, Κοντάκιον Πίστιν Χριστοῦ.

    Τῇ Παρασκευῇ τῆς Β΄, Γ΄ καὶ Δ΄ ἑβδομάδος, ἡ αὐτή ἐστι τῆς Ἀκολουθίας διάταξις (ἐξαιρουμένων ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τῆς Προηγιασμένης τῶν Στιχηρῶν τοῦ ἁγίου Θεοδώρου), ψάλλεται δὲ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῆς ἡμέρας δίς, τὰ δ΄ τοῦ ἤχου Μαρτυρικὰ καὶ δ΄ τῶν Ἁγίων. Δόξα, τῶν Ἁγίων, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου κτλ. ὡς ἀνωτέρω.

### Δ΄.

7.    Εἰ τύχοι τῷ Σαββάτῳ τῆς Α΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Παρασκευῇ πρωῒ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Δεῦτε πιστοὶ δίς, δ΄ Προσόμοια τῶν Μαρτύρων καὶ δ΄ τοῦ ἁγίου Θεοδώρου, Δόξα, Ὀργάνῳ χρησάμενος, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ τυχόντος ἤχου, Εἴσοδος μετὰ θυμιατοῦ. Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν Γεύσασθε, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

## March 9: The Holy Forty Martyrs [in the Lake of Sebastea] (Situation II Concl., Situation III § 6, Situation IV § 7) [Violakis, p. 421]

### SITUATION THREE

6.    If the Feast occurs on Friday of this week: on Thursday morning Vespers is chanted as prescribed in Situation One, Paragraph 1. On Friday morning, we chant Matins until the Doxology and the Hours as prescribed in Situation One, Paragraph 2. At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we sing the Idiomelon: **"Come, ye faithful"** (*Δεῦτε πιστοὶ*) twice, 4 Prosomia of the Martyrs, and 4 of St. Theodore; "Glory...": **"In songs and hymns let us praise"** (*Ἐν ᾠδαῖς ἀσμάτων*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone occurring; Little Entrance with the Holy Gospel Book, "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX], then the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints; and then follows the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts; Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal. In the evening, the Ikoi of the Theotokos [the Akathist Stasis] are read, as is the custom, with the Kontakion: **"Thy faith in Christ was like a breastplate"** (*Πίστιν Χριστοῦ*).

    On Friday of the Second, Third, and Fourth Week, the order of service is the same (excluding at Vespers of the Presanctified the Stichira of St. Theodore); the Idiomelon of the day is then chanted twice, as well as the 4 Martyrika of the Tone and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone, etc., as above.

### SITUATION FOUR

7. # Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation IV Concl.; Situation V Opening §§ 8–9)

## Τῇ Θ΄: Τῶν Ἁγίων Μ΄ Μαρτύρων (Περιπτώσεις Δ΄ Τέλος, Ε΄ Ἀρχὴ §§ 8–9) [Violakis, p. 422]

Τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀναγινώσκονται οἱ Οἶκοι τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὡς εἴθισται, Κοντάκιον Πᾶσαν στρατιάν.

Τῷ δὲ Σαββάτῳ πρωῒ ὁ Ὄρθρος μετὰ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου ψάλλονται, ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν τῇ τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους ἑορτῇ, ἐν περιπτώσει ΙΒ΄ § 21. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, ὁ Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ἁγίων. Κοινωνικόν, Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

Δόξα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. # Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation IV Concl.; Situation V Opening §§ 8–9)

## March 9: The Holy Forty Martyrs [in the Lake of Sebastea] (Situation IV Concl., Situation V Opening §§ 8–9) [Violakis, p. 423]

In the evening, the Ikoi of the Theotokos [the Akathist Stasis] are read, as is the custom, with the Kontakion: **"Every army"** (*Πᾶσαν στρατιάν*).

On Saturday morning, Matins with the Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom are sung, as prescribed in the Feast of the Holy Hieromartyr Charalampos under Situation Twelve, Paragraph 21. At the Liturgy, the Epistle of the Triodion [Heb. 1:1–12] and Gospel of the Saints; Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); "We have seen the true light", and Dismissal.

### SITUATION FIVE

8.    If the Commemoration of the Saints occurs on the First, Second, Third, Fourth, or Fifth Sunday of the Great Fast: on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at "Lord, I have cried", we sing 4 Resurrectional hymns of the Tone of the week, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": the first Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone occurring; Little Entrance, "O Gladsome Light", and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; "Glory...": of the Saints: **"David cried out prophetically"** (*Προφητικῶς ἀνεβόων*); "Both now and ever...": on the 2nd, 4th, or 5th Sunday: **"O extraordinary marvel"** (*Ὢ θαύματος καινοῦ*); on the 1st and 3rd Sundays, the Theotokia of the Triodion; the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, of the Triodion, and the Theotokion (on the 1st and 3rd Sundays: the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection, that of the Martyrs, and instead of the Theotokion the Dismissal Troparia of the Triodion: **"We venerate Thy most pure icon"** [*Τὴν ἄχραντον εἰκόνα σου*] on the 1st Sunday, or **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** [*Σῶσον Κύριε τὸν λαόν σου*] on the 3rd Sunday), and Dismissal.

9.    On Sunday morning at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon; then the Liti; "Glory...": of the Saints: **"In songs and hymns let us praise"** (*Ἐν ᾠδαῖς ἀσμάτων*); "Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, thou art the true vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*); on the 1st Sunday, "Both now and ever...": **"Rejoice, O venerable prophets"** (*Χαίρετε Προφῆται τίμιοι*); on the 3rd Sunday: **"All creation beholding Thee"** (*Ὁρῶσά σε ἡ κτίσις ἅπασα*); and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"**; then the Trisagion Prayers; the Dismissal Troparion of the Martyrs (this is replaced on the 1st Sunday with **"We venerate Thy most pure icon"**, and on the 3rd Sunday with **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"**); and the Hexapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata in order, and the Kathisma of the third Stichologia of the Saints (on the 3rd Sunday, the last Kathisma of the Saints, and instead of the Theotokion: **"In Paradise of old"** [*Ἐν Παραδείσῳ μὲν τὸ πρίν*]); then the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and of the Triodion (on the 3rd Sunday: the Canon of the Triodion and that of the Saints); after the 3rd Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, then the Kathismata of the Triodion, of the Saints, and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and...[^278]

# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation V Concl. §§ 9–10; Situation VI § 11)

## Τῇ Θ΄: Τῶν Ἁγίων Μ΄ Μαρτύρων (Περιπτώσεις Ε΄ Τέλος §§ 9–10, Ϛ΄ § 11) [Violakis, p. 424]

Οἶκος, τὰ τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς, αἱ Καταβασίαι ἐν μὲν τῇ Α΄ καὶ Γ΄ Κυριακῇ τοῦ Τριῳδίου, ἐν δὲ τῇ Β΄, Δ΄ καὶ Ε΄ Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου. Εἶτα Στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ἐν μὲν τῇ Α΄ καὶ Γ΄ Κυριακῇ Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ τῶν Μαρτύρων γ΄, ἐν δὲ τῇ Β΄ μετὰ τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα ἔρχονται τὰ τῶν Μαρτύρων καὶ ἕπονται τὰ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τῶν ἁρμοδίων Στίχων· καὶ ἐν τῇ Δ΄ καὶ Ε΄ Ἀναστάσιμα ε΄ καὶ τῶν Μαρτύρων γ΄, ὧν οἱ Στίχοι ἐν τοῖς δυσὶ τελευταίοις Τροπαρίοις Θαυμαστὸς ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τοῖς Ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ, καὶ Τοῖς Ἁγίοις τοῖς ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ ἐθαυμάστωσεν ὁ Κύριος, Δόξα, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον Σωτηρία.

10.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄ (ἐν δὲ τῇ Α΄ καὶ τῇ Γ΄ Κυριακῇ τὰ Ἀντίφωνα ὡς εἰσιν ὡρισμένα· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, ἐν μὲν τῇ Α΄ καὶ Γ΄ Κυριακῇ τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Τριῳδίου τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ· ἐν δὲ ταῖς λοιπαῖς Κυριακαῖς, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον τῶν Ἁγίων, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, καὶ τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ. Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ, Ἀπόστολος τῶν τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου· Κοινωνικὸν ἐν τῇ Γ΄ Κυριακῇ Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ᾿ ἡμᾶς, ἐν ταῖς λοιπαῖς Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς, ἐν δὲ τῇ Γ΄ Κυριακῇ Σῶσον Κύριε, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις

### Ϛ΄.

11.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Δευτέρᾳ τῆς Β΄, Γ΄, Δ΄, Ε΄, καὶ ΣΤ΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Κυριακῇ ἑσπέρας, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Στιχηρὰ ς΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τῶν Ἁγίων. Δόξα, Τὴν λίμνην ὡς παράδεισον, Καὶ νῦν Θεοτοκίον Ἔργοις σκοτεινοῖς, Εἴσοδος Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Μέγα Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὸ Ἰδιόμελον ἀργῶς δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ. Δόξα Προφητικῶς ἀνεβόα, Καὶ νῦν Τὴν πᾶσαν ἐλπίδα μου, Νῦν ἀπολύεις, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια Τὰς ἀλγηδόνας τῶν ἁγίων, Τοῦ Γαβριὴλ φθεγξαμένου σοι, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Τὸ Θεοτόκε παρθένε οὐ ψάλλεται διὰ τὸ τελεῖσθαι αὔριον Προηγιασμένην.

*(Printed Page 424)*

# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation V Concl. §§ 9–10; Situation VI § 11)

## March 9: The Holy Forty Martyrs [in the Lake of Sebastea] (Situation V Concl. §§ 9–10, Situation VI § 11) [Violakis, p. 425]

Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Sunday. The Katavasiai: on the 1st and 3rd Sundays, those of the Triodion; on the 2nd, 4th, or 5th Sunday: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*). Then we chant with verses "More honorable than the Cherubim"; Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, of the Saints, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: on the 1st and 3rd Sundays, we chant 2 hymns of the Resurrection, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 of the Martyrs; on the 2nd Sunday, after those of the Resurrection, we chant those of the Martyrs and then those of the Saint [St. Gregory Palamas] with the appropriate verses; on the 4th and 5th Sundays, we chant 5 hymns of the Resurrection and 3 of the Martyrs, with the following Verses at the last two: **"Wondrous is God in His Saints"** (*Θαυμαστὸς ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τοῖς Ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ*, Ps. 67:36 LXX) and **"In the saints that are in His earth, the Lord hath magnified all His good pleasure"** (*Τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ ἐθαυμάστωσεν ὁ Κύριος*, Ps. 15:3 LXX); "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

10.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes of the Tone in 4, and 4 of the Saints (on the 1st and 3rd Sundays, we chant the Antiphons as they are appointed); after the Little Entrance, on the 1st and 3rd Sundays, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, of the Saints, and that of the Patron Saint of the Temple; on the other Sundays, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, of the Triodion, and that of the Patron Saint of the Temple. Kontakion: **"To thee, the champion leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*); the Epistle of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday, and then the Divine Liturgy of St. Basil the Great; Communion Verse: on the 3rd Sunday, **"The light of Thy countenance is signed upon us, O Lord"** (*Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ᾿ ἡμᾶς τὸ φῶς τοῦ προσώπου σου, Κύριε*, Ps. 4:7 LXX); on the other Sundays: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); "We have seen the true light", but on the 3rd Sunday **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** [Ps. 27:9 LXX], and Dismissal.

### SITUATION SIX

11.    If the Feast occurs on Monday of the Second, Third, Fourth, Fifth, or Sixth Week: on Sunday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we sing 6 Stichira: 3 Prosomia of the Triodion and 3 of the Saints; "Glory...": **"The lake as paradise"** (*Τὴν λίμνην ὡς παράδεισον*); "Both now and ever...": Theotokion: **"By dark works"** (*Ἔργοις σκοτεινοῖς*); Little Entrance, "O Gladsome Light", and the Great Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon is sung twice slowly, and the Martyrikon once; "Glory...": **"David cried out prophetically in the psalms"** (*Προφητικῶς ἀνεβόα*); "Both now and ever...": **"All my hope I place in thee, O Mother of God"** (*Τὴν πᾶσαν ἐλπίδα μου*); **"Now let Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29), the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparia: **"By reason of the sufferings which the Saints endured for Thy sake, O Lord"** (*Τὰς ἀλγηδόνας τῶν Ἁγίων*), and **"When Gabriel said unto thee"** (*Τοῦ Γαβριὴλ φθεγξαμένου σοι*), and Dismissal. The hymn **"Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*) is not sung because tomorrow the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts will be celebrated.[^279]

*(Printed Page 425)*

# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situations VI Concl., VII § 12, VIII § 13)

## Τῇ Θ΄: Τῶν Ἁγίων Μ΄ Μαρτύρων (Περιπτώσεις Ϛ΄ Τέλος, Ζ΄ § 12, Η΄ § 13) [Violakis, p. 426]

    Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωῒ ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου, αἱ Ὧραι καὶ ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, ψάλλονται ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν τῇ Α΄ περιπτώσει § 2, 3.
    Εἰ δὲ τύχοι τῇ Τρίτῃ τῆς Β΄, Γ΄, Δ΄ καὶ Ε΄ ἑβδομάδος, ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τῆς Προηγιασμένης, τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῶν Ἀποστίχων τῆς ἡμέρας δίς, τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς Προσόμοια καὶ δ΄ τῶν Ἁγίων, Δόξα, τῶν Ἁγίων, Καὶ νῦν, Προσόμοιον Σταυροθεοτοκίον κτλ. ὡς ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2, 3.

### Ζ΄.

12.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Δ΄ ἑβδομάδος, τὸ πρωῒ ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου ψάλλεται ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2, 3, αἱ δὲ Ὧραι ἀναγινώσκονται λιταὶ καὶ λέγομεν ἀντὶ τοῦ Τὸ πρωῒ εἰσάκουσον τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ Κύριε ὁ τὸ Πανάγιόν σου κτλ. Τὸν Σταυρόν σου Προσκυνοῦμεν Δέσποτα. Ἀπολυτίκιον Τὰς ἀλγηδόνας τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ Κοντάκιον Οὐκέτι φλογίνη ῥομφαία. Ἐν δὲ τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ δύο Ἰδιόμελα καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ Προσόμοια, καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄, Δόξα, Τὴν λίμνην ὡς παράδεισον, Καὶ νῦν, Σήμερον ὁ ἀπρόσιτος τῇ οὐσίᾳ, Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Μαρτύρων, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Η΄.

13.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Σαββάτῳ τῆς Β΄, Γ΄ καὶ Δ΄ ἑβδομάδος: τῇ Παρασκευῇ πρωῒ εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῆς ἡμέρας δίς, δ΄ Μαρτυρικὰ τοῦ τυχόντος ἤχου καὶ δ΄ τῶν Ἁγίων, Δόξα, Ἐν ᾠδαῖς ᾀσμάτων, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος μετὰ θυμιατοῦ, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν Γεύσασθε καὶ ἴδετε, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀναγινώσκονται οἱ Οἶκοι τῆς Θεοτόκου ὡς εἴθισται.

# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situations VI Concl., VII § 12, VIII § 13)

## March 9: The Holy Forty Martyrs [in the Lake of Sebastea] (Situations VI Concl., VII § 12, VIII § 13) [Violakis, p. 427]

    On Monday morning the Service of Matins, the Hours and the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts are chanted as prescribed in Situation One, Paragraphs 2 and 3.
    If the Feast occurs on Tuesday of the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, or 5th Week: in the Vespers of the Presanctified, the Idiomelon of the Aposticha of the day twice, the Martyrikon once, the 3 Prosomia of the sequence, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": Prosomion Stavrotheotokion, etc., as in Situation One, Paragraphs 2 and 3.

### SITUATION SEVEN

12.    If the Feast occurs on Wednesday of the 4th Week [Mid-Lent Wednesday]: in the morning the Service of Matins is sung as prescribed in Situation One, Paragraphs 2 and 3; the Hours are read plainly, and instead of **"In the morning hear my voice"** and **"O Lord, Who at the third hour didst send down Thy Most Holy Spirit..."** etc., we say: **"Thy Cross do we adore, O Master"** (*Τὸν Σταυρόν σου Προσκυνοῦμεν Δέσποτα*). Dismissal Troparion: **"By reason of the sufferings which the Saints endured for Thy sake, O Lord"** (*Τὰς ἀλγηδόνας τῶν Ἁγίων*); and Kontakion: **"No longer doth the flaming sword"** (*Οὐκέτι φλογίνη ῥομφαία*). In Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried": the two Idiomela and the Martyrikon, the 3 Prosomia of the Triodion, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": **"The lake as paradise"** (*Τὴν λίμνην ὡς παράδεισον*); "Both now and ever...": **"Today He Who is unapproachable in essence"** (*Σήμερον ὁ ἀπρόσιτος τῇ οὐσίᾳ*); Entrance with the Holy Gospel Book, "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX], the Epistle and Gospel of the Martyrs, and then the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in due order; Communion Verse: **"In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

### SITUATION EIGHT

13.    If the Feast occurs on Saturday of the 2nd, 3rd, or 4th Week: on Friday morning at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we sing the Idiomelon of the day twice, 4 Martyrika in the Tone occurring, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": **"In songs and hymns let us praise"** (*Ἐν ᾠδαῖς ᾀσμάτων*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone; Entrance with the censer, "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX], and then the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in due order; Communion Verse: **"O taste and see"** (*Γεύσασθε καὶ ἴδετε*, Ps. 33:9 LXX); **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal. In the evening, the Oikoi of the Theotokos [Akathist Stasis] are read as customary, with the Kontakion: **"Every army"** (*Πᾶσαν στρατιάν*).[^280]

# Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situations VIII Concl. § 13, IX § 14, X § 15)

## Τῇ Θ΄: Τῶν Ἁγίων Μ΄ Μαρτύρων (Περιπτώσεις Η΄ Τέλος § 13, Θ΄ § 14, Ι΄ § 15) [Violakis, p. 428]

    Κοντάκιον Πᾶσαν στρατιάν.
    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ πρωῒ ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου μετὰ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου ψάλλονται κατὰ τὴν γνωστὴν διάταξιν. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ἁγίων. Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον.

### Θ΄.

14.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Ε΄ ἑβδομάδος, τὸ πρωῒ ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου καὶ τῶν Ὡρῶν ψάλλεται ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2. Ἐν δὲ τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἀρχόμεθα ἀπὸ τοῦ Στίχου Πεσοῦνται ἐν ἀμφιβλήστρῳ αὐτῶν οἱ ἁμαρτωλοί, καὶ ψάλλομεν τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῆς ἡμέρας δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, εἶτα τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου Προσόμοια, καὶ δ΄ τῶν Ἁγίων Φέροντες τὰ παρόντα γενναίως, καὶ ἀκολούθως κατ᾿ ἀλφάβητον Στιχηρὰ τοῦ Τριῳδίου Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου, μέχρι τοῦ Στιχηροῦ Ὢ τῆς ἀφάτου σου εὐσπλαγχνίας· Δόξα, τῶν Ἁγίων, Τὴν λίμνην ὡς παράδεισον, Καὶ νῦν, Ἔργοις σκοτεινοῖς συναπαχθείς. Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
    Τὸ ἑσπέρας ψάλλεται ὁ Μ. Κανών, ὡς εἴθισται, μετὰ μικροῦ Ἀποδείπνου.

### Ι΄.

15.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Πέμπτῃ τοῦ Μεγάλου Κανόνος, τῇ Τετάρτῃ πρωῒ ὁ Ἑσπερινὸς καὶ ἡ Λειτουργία ψάλλονται ὡς ἐν περιπτώσει Θ΄ § 14· ἀλλὰ Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον, ὡς καὶ τὸ Δοξαστικόν, οὐ λέγονται, Κοινωνικὸν δὲ τὸ Γεύσασθε. Τῇ Πέμπτῃ πρωΐ, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. # Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situations VIII Concl. § 13, IX § 14, X § 15)

## March 9: The Holy Forty Martyrs [in the Lake of Sebastea] (Situations VIII Concl. § 13, IX § 14, X § 15) [Violakis, p. 429]

    Kontakion: **"Every army"** (*Πᾶσαν στρατιάν*).
    On Saturday morning, the Service of Matins with the Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom are sung according to the known order; Epistle and Gospel of the Saints; Communion Verse: **"In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX).

### SITUATION NINE

14.    If the Feast occurs on Wednesday of the 5th Week: in the morning, the Service of Matins and the Hours are sung as prescribed in Situation One, Paragraph 2. At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we begin from the Verse: **"The sinners shall fall into their net"** [Ps. 140:10 LXX], and we sing the Idiomelon of the day twice, and the Martyrikon; then the 3 Prosomia of the sequence of the Triodion, and 4 of the Saints: **"Bravely enduring the sufferings of the present life"** (*Φέροντες τὰ παρόντα γενναίως*); and following these, the alphabetical Stichira of the Triodion: **"All my life"** (*Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου*), until the Stichiron: **"O Thine ineffable loving-kindness"** (*Ὢ τῆς ἀφάτου σου εὐσπλαγχνίας*); "Glory...": of the Saints: **"The lake as paradise"** (*Τὴν λίμνην ὡς παράδεισον*); "Both now and ever...": **"Led away by works of darkness"** (*Ἔργοις σκοτεινοῖς συναπαχθείς*); Entrance with the Holy Gospel Book, "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX], the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints, and then the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in due order; Communion Verse: **"In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.
    In the evening, the Great Canon is chanted, as customary, with the Small Compline.

### SITUATION TEN

15.    If the Feast occurs on Thursday of the Great Canon: on Wednesday morning, Vespers and the Liturgy are sung as in Situation Nine, Paragraph 14; but the Epistle and Gospel, as well as the Doxastikon, are not said; Communion Verse: **"O taste and see"** (*Γεύσασθε καὶ ἴδετε*, Ps. 33:9 LXX). On Thursday morning, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints, and the Hexapsalmos. #### Α΄.

Σημείωσις.    Ἐὰν ἡ παραμονὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ Εὐαγγελισμοῦ τύχῃ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Τετάρτῃ ἢ Παρασκευῇ, ἐν αἷς, ὡς ἔθος, τελεῖται Προηγιασμένη Λειτουργία, ἐν μὲν ταῖς Ἱεραῖς Ἐκκλησίαις τῶν πόλεων οὐ τελεῖται Προηγιασμένη διὰ τὸ μηδὲ ἀγρυπνίαν τελεῖσθαι ἐν ταύταις ἐξαιρουμένης τῆς Μεγάλης Τρίτης καὶ Μ. # Month of March: The Holy Forty Martyrs (Situation XII Concl. § 21); The Annunciation (Situation I § 1)

## March 9: The Holy Forty Martyrs [in the Lake of Sebastea] (Situation XII Concl. § 21) [Violakis, p. 435]

21.    At the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes: 4 troparia from the 3rd Ode of the Canon of the Theotokos, and 4 from the 6th Ode of that of the Saints. At the Entrance: **"O come, let us worship and bow down before Christ; save us, O Son of God, wondrous art Thou in the Saints, who sing to Thee: Alleluia"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν... ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*), **"Taking knowledge of the secret command"** (*Τὸ προσταχθὲν μυστικῶς*), that of the Saints, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*). Epistle of the Saints and Gospel: **"Mary arose"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56). At "Especially": **"Let all earth-born mortals rejoice in spirit"** (*Ἅπας γηγενής*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and I will call upon the name of the Lord"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου*, Ps. 115:4 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.
    Note that the commemoration of the Holy Forty Martyrs may concur within the Triodion period from Wednesday of the First Week of the Great Fast until Great and Holy Monday of Passion Week (See the Festal Paschalion Chart).

# The 25th Day of March: The Annunciation of Our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary

## March 25: The Annunciation of Our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary (Situation I § 1) [Violakis, p. 435]

### SITUATIONS

#### SITUATION ONE

Note: If the Paramony [Eve] of the Feast of the Annunciation falls on a Wednesday or Friday, on which days, according to custom, the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts is celebrated: in the holy parish churches of the cities the Presanctified Liturgy is not celebrated, because an all-night vigil is not kept in them (except on Great and Holy Tuesday and Great and Holy Wednesday, on which the Presanctified Liturgy is celebrated following Small Vespers). In the holy monasteries, however, owing to the distinction of the monastic way of life and because all-night vigils are always celebrated therein, the Presanctified Liturgy is celebrated on the Paramony following Small Vespers, the ancient monastic typika remaining immovable.
1.    If the Feast of the Annunciation falls on Friday of the 3rd Week of the Great Fast: on Wednesday morning at the Vespers of the Presanctified Liturgy, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we sing [from the Triodion] the Idiomelon of the day twice, and the Martyrikon once; then the 3 Prosomia of the sequence of the Triodion, and 4 Forefeast Prosomia: **"A hidden mystery"** (*Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριὴλ*); Little Entrance, "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day; then **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX], and the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in due order. Then in the evening, the Great[^284]

After the Litany, **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*) with its verses, and the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion. The Psalter of the day, the Penitential Kathismata of the Octoechos and of the Triodion, Psalm 50 [LXX], the Biblical Odes, and the Forefeast Canon: **"O world, rejoice exceeding gladly"** (*Ὁ Κόσμος περιχαρῶς εὐφράνθητι*) together with the Triodia of the day. After the 3rd Ode, the Forefeast Kathisma: **"Today all of creation hails"** (*Σήμερον ἅπασα*); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion: **"Upon the descent of the All-Holy Spirit"** (*Ἐπελεύσει Πνεύματος τοῦ Παναγίου*), and the Menologion of the Saints of the day. After the Canons, the Heirmos of the 8th Ode: **"Daniel stretched forth his hands"** (*Χεῖρας ἐκπετάσας Δανιὴλ*), and we sing the Magnification: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβίμ*). Both now and ever...": **"A tongue which she knew not"** (*Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω*). Then **"It is good to give thanks unto the Lord"** (*Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι τῷ Κυρίῳ*, Ps. 91:2 LXX), the Trisagion Prayers, the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion: **"Today are the preludes of universal joy"** (*Σήμερον τῆς παγκοσμίου χαρᾶς τὰ προοίμια*), and the Hours are read plainly, in which we say the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion and Kontakion, with the Dismissal after the 6th Hour. The 9th Hour is read in the evening before Vespers, as is customary, at which we say the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion and Kontakion.

At "Especially": **"O earth, announce good tidings of great joy . . . As a living ark of God"** (*Εὐαγγελίζου γῆ χαρὰν μεγάλην . . . ### The Apodosis

6. Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela: **"In the sixth month"** (*Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια*); and after **"Now let Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*), **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ Ὑπερμάχῳ*) is sung slowly, and the Oikoi of the Theotokos [the Akathist Hymn] are read as is customary. At the conclusion of the Oikoi, **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** again at a brisk tempo, the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion three times, and Dismissal.
7.    On Saturday at Matins, after the Midnight Service, the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion three times; the Psalter of the day, the two Kathismata of the First and Second Stasis of the Feast, Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly, and the Canons of the Feast and of the Archangel. # Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation VI Concl. § 21; Situation VII § 22; Situation VIII §§ 23–24)

## Τῇ ΚΕ΄: Ὁ Εὐαγγελισμὸς τῆς Θεοτόκου (Περίπτωσις ΣΤ΄ Τέλος § 21, Περίπτωσις Ζ΄ § 22, Περίπτωσις Η΄ §§ 23–24) [Violakis, p. 452]

    § 2. Ὁ Μ. Ἑσπερινὸς καὶ ὁ Ὄρθρος τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου, ὡς διετυπώθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 3, 5, ἡ δὲ Ἀπόδοσις τῇ αὐτῇ ἑσπέρᾳ, ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Γ΄ § 18.

### Ζ΄.

22.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Παρασκευῇ τῆς Δ΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Τετάρτῃ πρωῒ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ δύο Ἰδιόμελα τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν καὶ γ΄ Προεόρτια Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Σήμερον ὁ ἀπρόσιτος τῇ οὐσίᾳ, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων.
    Τῇ Πέμπτῃ πρωΐ, ὁ Ὄρθρος τῆς Παραμονῆς καὶ αἱ Ὧραι ψάλλονται ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2. Μετὰ τὴν Εὐχὴν τῆς ς΄ Ὥρας Ἀπόλυσις.
    Τῇ Πέμπτῃ ἑσπέρας, ὁ Μ. Ἑσπερινὸς καὶ τῷ πρωῒ τῇ Παρασκευῇ ὁ Ὄρθρος τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου ψάλλονται, ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 3, 5.
    Ἡ ἀπόδοσις τῇ αὐτῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας, ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 6, 7, 8.

### Η΄.

23.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῷ Σαββάτῳ τῆς Δ΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Πέμπτῃ πρωῒ ὁ προεόρτιος Ἑσπερινὸς ψάλλεται, ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Β΄ § 9. Τῇ Παρασκευῇ πρωῒ ὁ Ὄρθρος καὶ αἱ Ὧραι ὡς ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2. Μετὰ τὴν Εὐχὴν τῆς ς΄ Ὥρας, Ἀπόλυσις.

    Τὸ ἑσπέρας τῆς Παρασκευῆς, ὁ Μ. Ἑσπερινὸς καὶ τῷ Σαββάτῳ ὁ Ὄρθρος τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου ψάλλονται ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Β § 10.

### Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις.

# Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation VI Concl. § 21; Situation VII § 22; Situation VIII §§ 23–24)

## March 25: The Annunciation of Our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary (Situation VI Concl. § 21; Situation VII § 22; Situation VIII §§ 23–24) [Violakis, p. 453]

    § 2. Great Vespers and the Matins of the Feast together with the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom are celebrated as formulated in Situation One, §§ 3 and 5; and the Apodosis on that same evening is chanted as prescribed in Situation Three, § 18.

### SITUATION SEVEN

22.    If the Feast occurs on Friday of the 4th Week: on Wednesday morning, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 2 Idiomela of the sequence of the Triodion, the Martyrikon, and 3 Forefeast Prosomia: **"A hidden mystery"** (*Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today He Who is unapproachable in essence"** (*Σήμερον ὁ ἀπρόσιτος τῇ οὐσίᾳ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Readings of the day, **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in due order.
    On Thursday morning, the Matins of the Paramony and the Hours are chanted as prescribed in Situation One, § 2; after the Prayer of the 6th Hour, Dismissal.
    On Thursday evening, Great Vespers, and on Friday morning, the Matins of the Feast together with the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom are chanted as prescribed in Situation One, §§ 3 and 5.
    The Apodosis on that same Friday evening is conducted as prescribed in Situation One, §§ 6, 7, and 8.

### SITUATION EIGHT

23.    If the Feast occurs on Saturday of the 4th Week: on Thursday morning, Forefeast Vespers is chanted as prescribed in Situation Two, § 9. On Friday morning, Matins and the Hours as in Situation One, § 2; after the Prayer of the 6th Hour, Dismissal.
    On Friday evening, Great Vespers, and on Saturday, Matins of the Feast together with the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom are chanted as prescribed in Situation Two, § 10.

Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου Ὁ Μέγας στρατηγὸς καὶ Τῶν Ἀσωμάτων λειτουργῶν (Ὅρα τῇ Κς΄)· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, καὶ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου δ΄ (ὧδε ἀποδίδοται ἡ ἑορτή), Δόξα, τῶν Αἴνων Δεῦτε ἐργασώμεθα, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. Σήμερον σωτηρία καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου. Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ.

# Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation VIII Concl. §§ 24–25; Situation IX § 26)

## March 25: The Annunciation of Our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary (Situation VIII Concl. §§ 24–25; Situation IX § 26) [Violakis, p. 455]

    Psalter [Kathisma 1, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Feast, and 3 of the Archangel; "Glory...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Let the heavens rejoice"** (*Εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοί*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.
    The Office of Saint John of the Ladder is chanted at Compline.
25.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, the Psalter of the day, and the Amomos [Kathisma 17, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Kathismata at the First and Second Psalter readings [Stichologiai]: two of the Resurrection and one of the Feast. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: that of the Resurrection and that of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathismata of the Archangel: **"The great leader of the hosts"** (*Ὁ Μέγας στρατηγὸς*) and **"Of the bodiless ministers"** (*Τῶν Ἀσωμάτων λειτουργῶν*, see March 26); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire Sunday Matins Gospel order as prescribed for the Sundays of the Triodion; then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and those of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Archangel (at this point the Apodosis of the Feast takes place); "Glory..." at the Praises: **"Come, let us work in the mystical vineyard"** (*Δεῦτε ἐργασώμεθα*); "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology; **"Today is salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*), and following in order the Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil the Great. Kontakion: **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*).

### SITUATION NINE

26.    If the Feast occurs on the 4th Sunday of Great Lent: on Friday at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the Idiomelon: **"Having enslaved my soul to passions"** (*Τοῖς πάθεσι δουλώσας*) twice, the 4 Martyrika of the Tone, and 4 Forefeast Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the day [Genesis 12:1–7; Proverbs 14:15–26]. Then **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in due order.
    In the evening, the Fourth Stasis of the Oikoi of the Theotokos [the Akathist Hymn] is read with Small Compline, as is customary. Kontakion after the Trisagion Prayers: **"Upon the descent of the All-Holy Spirit"** (*Ἐπελεύσει Πνεύματος τοῦ Παναγίου*).
    On Saturday, the Matins of the Paramony and the Divine Liturgy as prescribed[^294]

# Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation IX Concl. §§ 27–29)

## Τῇ ΚΕ΄: Ὁ Εὐαγγελισμὸς τῆς Θεοτόκου (Περίπτωσις Θ΄ Τέλος §§ 27–29) [Violakis, p. 456]

    ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Γ΄ § 13, 14.
27.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἐν τῷ Μ. Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς ς΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

28.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεὸς τὸ Τρισάγιον, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς (καταλιμπανομένου τοῦ Τριαδικοῦ κανόνος, ψάλλεται ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς), εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τῆς ἑορτῆς. Καθίσματα ἐν μὲν τῇ α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίᾳ ἀνὰ δύο Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἐν δὲ τῇ γ΄ μόνα τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἡ Αἴτησις, καὶ μετ᾿ αὐτὴν ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἑορτῆς Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ αὐτό, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ Λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἅπαξ· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς· Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς· εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος μυστήριον, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ Σήμερον Σωτηρία.

29.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Κοντάκιον Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως τὸ Εὐαγγελίζου γῆ (χαρὰν μεγάλην . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ κιβωτῷ), Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὁσίου (Ἰωάννου) ψάλλεται ἐν τοῖς Ἀποδείπνοις.
    Τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀποδίδοται ἡ ἑορτή, ὡς προδιετυπώθη ἐν περιπτώσει Γ΄ § 18.

# Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation IX Concl. §§ 27–29)

## March 25: The Annunciation of Our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary (Situation IX Concl. §§ 27–29) [Violakis, p. 457]

    in Situation Three, §§ 13 and 14.
27.    On Saturday at Great Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the reading of the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 of the Feast; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the Feast. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.
28.    On Sunday at Matins, after **"Blessed is our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός*), the Trisagion Prayers, and Psalm 50 [LXX] (the Triadic Canon being omitted, the Liti of the Feast is chanted); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, the Psalter reading of the day, and the Polyeleos of the Feast. Kathismata: at the First and Second Psalter readings [Stichologiai], two of the Resurrection and one of the Feast; at the third reading, those of the Feast alone; the Litany, and after it the Hypakoe of the Tone and the Anavathmoi; the Prokeimenon of the Feast: **"Proclaim His salvation from day to day"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας*, Ps. 95:2 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel: **"Mary arose"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56). Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); "Both now and ever...": repeat the same; the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:3 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Canons: that of the Resurrection and that of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion with the Ikos, then the Kathisma: **"The Word of God"** (*Ὁ Λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ*) once; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the 9th Ode of the Feast. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and those of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Feast; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"The mystery hidden from all eternity"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος μυστήριον*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).
29.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast; the Entrance Hymn (Eisodikon): **"Proclaim His salvation from day to day... Save us, O Son of God, Who art risen from the dead..."** (*Εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, and the Kontakion: **"To thee, the Champion Leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*). Epistle and Gospel of the Feast. At "Especially": **"O earth, announce good tidings of great joy . . . As a living ark of God"** (*Εὐαγγελίζου γῆ χαρὰν μεγάλην . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ Θεοῦ κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse of the Feast [Ps. 131:13 LXX]; **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal. The Office of the Venerable Father [John of the Ladder] is chanted at Compline.
    The Apodosis of the Feast takes place that evening as previously prescribed in Situation Three, § 18.[^295]

# Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation X §§ 30–31)

## Τῇ ΚΕ΄: Ὁ Εὐαγγελισμὸς τῆς Θεοτόκου (Περίπτωσις Ι΄ §§ 30–31) [Violakis, p. 458]

### Ι΄.

30.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Δευτέρᾳ τῆς Ε΄ καὶ ΣΤ΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, Προεόρτια γ΄, καὶ τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄. Δόξα, Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Προεόρτιον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

31.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ προεόρτιον Ἀπολυτίκιον, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τοῦ ἤχου, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ (κανονικὰ, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ προηγεῖται τῶν Ἀναβαθμῶν). Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ Προεόρτιος, οὗ ὁ Στίχος Δόξα, σοι ὁ Θεός· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ προεόρτιον Κάθισμα Σήμερον ἅπασα ἅπαξ· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ Προεόρτια Κατοικτιρήσας τῷ Πλάσματι ὁ Πλάστης δ΄. Δόξα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. Σήμερον σωτηρία, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Κοντάκιον Ἐπελεύσει Πνεύματος, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
    Τῇ αὐτῇ Κυριακῇ ἑσπέρας καὶ τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωΐ, ψάλλεται Ἀκολουθία τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου, ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 3-5.
    Τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀποδίδοται ἡ ἑορτή, ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Γ΄ § 18.

# Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation X §§ 30–31)

## March 25: The Annunciation of Our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary (Situation X §§ 30–31) [Violakis, p. 459]

### SITUATION TEN

30.    If the Feast occurs on Monday of the 5th Week [the printed text adds: "and the 6th Week", which is a typographical error; it must be the 5th Week, since Situations 11–15 treat the intervening days]: on Saturday at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the reading of the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Forefeast, and 3 of the Triodion; "Glory...": **"A tongue which she knew not"** (*Γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Triodion, that of the Forefeast, and Dismissal.
31.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Triodion, and that of the Forefeast; the Psalter and the Amomos [Kathisma 17, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata, the Evlogitaria, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon of the Tone, then the Hypakoe (canonically, the Hypakoe precedes the Anavathmoi). Canons: that of the Resurrection and that of the Forefeast, with the Verse: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee." After the 3rd Ode, the Forefeast Kathisma: **"Today the entire creation"** (*Σήμερον ἅπασα*) once; after the 6th Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, the Menologion, and the Synaxarion of the Triodion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel as prescribed for the Sundays of the Triodion; then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Triodion, and that of the Forefeast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast: **"Having compassion on His handiwork, the Creator"** (*Κατοικτιρήσας τῷ πλάσματι ὁ πλάστης*); "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, **"Today is salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*), and following in order the Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil the Great, in which the Typika and the Beatitudes are sung. Kontakion: **"Upon the descent of the All-Holy Spirit"** (*Ἐπελεύσει Πνεύματος τοῦ Παναγίου*); Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.
    On that Sunday evening and Monday morning, the Office of the Feast is chanted together with the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom, as prescribed in Situation One, §§ 3–5.
    The Apodosis of the Feast is celebrated that evening as prescribed in Situation Three, § 18.[^296]

### ΙΑ΄.

32.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Ε΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωῒ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου Προσόμοια, καὶ τὰ γ΄ Προεόρτια Κεκρυμμένον μυστήριον, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας. # Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation XI Opening §§ 32–34)

Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the day [Genesis 19:1–14; Proverbs 15:20 – 16:9]. At the Aposticha: the 2 Idiomela of the Triodion: **"As one who hath fallen among thieves"** (*Ὡς ὁ περιπεσών*) and **"Having stumbled through transgression"** (*Ἀποσφαλέντες ἐκ παραβάσεως*), and the Martyrikon; then the Alphabetical Stichira: **"All my life"** (*Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου*), with the Verse: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee" unto the end.     On Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning, the Office of the Feast is chanted together with the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom, as prescribed in Situation One, §§ 3–5.

Both now and ever...": **"He was sent from heaven"** (*Ἀπεστάλη ἐξ οὐρανοῦ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela of the Feast; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Today are the glad tidings of joy"** (*Σήμερον χαρᾶς εὐαγγέλια*); the Dismissal Troparion three times, and Dismissal.
34.    On Thursday morning, after the Midnight Service, the Penitential Troparia: **"Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us"** (*Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, Κύριε, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς*), and the Hexapsalmos. # Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation XI Concl. §§ 34–35 & Historical Note)

## Τῇ ΚΕ΄: Ὁ Εὐαγγελισμὸς τῆς Θεοτόκου (Περίπτωσις ΙΑ΄ Τέλος §§ 34–35) [Violakis, p. 462]

    Στιχολογία τῶν θ΄ Ὠδῶν καὶ ἡ α΄ καὶ γ΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου, ὁ Εἱρμός, ἡ Αἴτησις καὶ τὰ Καθίσματα τῆς γ΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου, εἶτα ἡ δ΄ Ὠδὴ μετὰ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ἡ ε΄ καὶ ἡ ς΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ ὁ Εἱρμός, ἡ Αἴτησις, τὸ Κοντάκιον Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον καὶ τὸ ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Εἶτα ἀντὶ τῆς ζ΄ Ὠδῆς, οἱ ἐν τῷ Τριῳδίῳ Μακαρισμοὶ μετὰ Στίχου Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, ἐλέησόν με· ἡ η΄ καὶ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου καὶ τὰ Τριῴδια τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς καὶ τῆς θ΄. Εἶτα Αἰνοῦμεν, εὐλογοῦμεν καὶ ὁ Εἱρμὸς Ὃν στρατιαί· μετὰ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἀσπόρου συλλήψεως, τὸ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Φωταγωγικόν, τὸ Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει καὶ μετὰ τὴν Ἐκτενῆ, τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ταῖς λῃστρικαῖς ἐφόδοις δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν.    Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοί, Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι τῷ Κυρίῳ, τὸ Τρισάγιον, Ἐν τῷ Ναῷ ἑστῶτες, τὸ Κύριε ἐλέησον μ΄, Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός, τὸ Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ, τὰς τρεῖς Μετανοίας (ἐδῶ ὑπονοεῖται ἡ Προσευχὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐφραίμ)· καὶ ἀναγινώσκονται αἱ Ὧραι λιταί, Ἀπολυτίκιον Τῶν οὐρανίων στρατιῶν καὶ Κοντάκιον Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου μετὰ τὴν θ΄ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, καὶ ἄρχεται ὁ Ἑσπερινός.

35.    Εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Αὐτεξουσίως ἐξεδύθην δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, καὶ γ΄ Προσόμοια τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὰ δύο Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, καὶ τὸ ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ Κύριος ἔκτησέ με, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν Γεύσασθε.

    Σημ. Τῷ ,αωπα΄, ἐπὶ τῆς πατριαρχείας Ἰωακεὶμ τοῦ Γ΄, συνέπεσεν ἡ ἑορτὴ τοῦ Εὐαγγελισμοῦ τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Ε΄ ἑβδομάδος καὶ ἐψάλη ὁ Μέγας Κανὼν κατ᾿ ἀπόφασιν Συνοδικὴν οὕτω· τὸ ἑσπέρας τῆς Τετάρτης, μετὰ τὴν τελείαν Ἀπόλυσιν τοῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ τῆς Ἀποδόσεως τῆς ἑορτῆς, εὐθὺς Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός, τὸ μικρὸν Ἀπόδειπνον· μετὰ τὸ Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις ἐψάλη ὁ Κανών, μετὰ τὴν Θ΄ Ὠδὴν ὁ Εἱρμὸς Ἀσπόρου συλλήψεως, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Κοντάκιον Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου, τὸ Κύριε ἐλέησον μ΄, Ὁ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ, τὸ Ἄσπιλε ἀμόλυντε κτλ. καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. # Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation XI Concl. §§ 34–35 & Historical Note)

## March 25: The Annunciation of Our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary (Situation XI Concl. §§ 34–35 & Historical Note) [Violakis, p. 463]

    Biblical Odes [Stichologia of the 9 Odes], and the 1st and 3rd Odes of the Canon of the Archangel, the Heirmos, the Litany, and the Kathismata of the 3rd Ode of the Archangel; then the 4th Ode with that of the Triodion, and the 5th and 6th Odes of the Archangel; after the 6th Ode, the Heirmos, the Litany, the Kontakion: **"My soul, my soul"** (*Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου*), the Menologion, and the Synaxarion of the Triodion. Then, instead of the 7th Ode, the Beatitudes in the Triodion with the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, ἐλέησόν με*); then the 8th and 9th Odes of the Archangel, and the Triodia of the 8th and 9th Odes. Then **"We praise, bless, and worship the Lord"** (*Αἰνοῦμεν, εὐλογοῦμεν*) and the Heirmos: **"Whom the hosts of heaven glorify"** (*Ὃν στρατιαὶ οὐρανῶν*); following **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**, we chant the Heirmos: **"Of conception without seed"** (*Ἀσπόρου συλλήψεως*). Then **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*), the Exaposteilarion, **"To Thee belongeth glory"** (*Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει*), and following the Litany, the Idiomelon of the Aposticha: **"By the assaults of thieves"** (*Ταῖς λῃστρικαῖς ἐφόδοις*) twice, and the Martyrikon; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Let the heavens rejoice"** (*Εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοί*); **"It is good to give thanks unto the Lord"** (*Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι*, Ps. 91:2 LXX), the Trisagion Prayers, **"Standing in the temple of Thy glory"** (*Ἐν τῷ ναῷ ἑστῶτες*), **"Lord, have mercy"** (40 times), **"He that is blessed"** (*Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός*), **"O Heavenly King"** (*Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ*), the three Great Prostrations (here the Prayer of Saint Ephraim is understood); and the plain Hours are read. Dismissal Troparion: **"O commanders of the heavenly hosts"** (*Τῶν οὐρανίων στρατιῶν*) and Kontakion: **"My soul, my soul"** (*Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου*); after the 9th Hour, the Beatitudes, and then Vespers begins.
35.    At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the Idiomelon: **"Of my own free will was I stripped"** (*Αὐτεξουσίως ἐξεδύθην*) twice, the Martyrikon once, and 3 Prosomia of the Archangel; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"In the sixth month"** (*Τῷ ἕκτῳ μηνί*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the two Readings from the Triodion [Genesis 18:20–33; Proverbs 16:17 – 17:17], and the one from the Menaion: **"The Lord created me"** (*Κύριος ἔκτησέ με*, Proverbs 8:22–30). Then **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in order; Communion Verse: **"O taste and see that the Lord is good"** (*Γεύσασθε καὶ ἴδετε*, Ps. 33:9 LXX).

    *Note*: In 1881, during the patriarchate of Joachim III, the Feast of the Annunciation occurred on Wednesday of the 5th Week, and by Synodical decision, the Great Canon was celebrated in this manner: on Wednesday evening, following the complete Dismissal of the Vespers of the Apodosis of the Feast, immediately **"Blessed is our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός*), and Small Compline; after **"Glory to God in the highest"** (*Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις*), the Great Canon was sung; after the 9th Ode, the Heirmos: **"Of conception without seed"** (*Ἀσπόρου συλλήψεως*). The Trisagion Prayers, the Kontakion: **"My soul, my soul"** (*Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου*); **"Lord, have mercy"** (40 times), **"Thou Who at all times and at every hour"** (*Ὁ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ*), **"O Lady, Bride of God, spotless, undefiled"** (*Ἄσπιλε, ἀμόλυντε*), etc., and Dismissal. On Thursday morning, Matins and the Presanctified Liturgy were celebrated as above in §§ 34 and 35.[^298]

=== LEAF p479 ===

# Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation XII § 36, Situation XIII § 37)

## Τῇ ΚΕ΄: Ὁ Εὐαγγελισμὸς τῆς Θεοτόκου (Περίπτωσις ΙΒ΄ § 36, Περίπτωσις ΙΓ΄ § 37) [Violakis, p. 464]

### ΙΒ΄.

36.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Πέμπτῃ τοῦ Μεγάλου Κανόνος, τῇ Τρίτῃ πρωῒ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ Προσόμοια, καὶ τὰ γ΄ Προεόρτια. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας. τὰ δύο Ἰδιόμελα τῶν Ἀποστίχων, τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν καὶ τὰ κατ᾿ ἀλφάβητον Στιχηρὰ Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου, ὁ Στίχος Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, Θεοτόκε Παρθένε, Κύριε ἐλέησον μ΄, Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ, τὰς γ΄ Μετανοίας, (ὑπονοεῖται ἐδῶ ἡ Προσευχὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐφραίμ) τὴν εὐχὴν Παναγία Τριάς, τὸ Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
    Τὸ ἑσπέρας τῆς αὐτῆς ἡμέρας (δήλ. Τρίτης), ψάλλεται μετ᾿ Ἀποδείπνου μικροῦ ὁ Μέγας Κανών, ὡς εἴθισται· μετὰ τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Κοντάκιον Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου κτλ. καὶ Ἀπόλυσις
    Τῇ Τετάρτῃ πρωΐ, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου τῆς Παραμονῆς καὶ αἱ Ὧραι ψάλλονται ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2· μετὰ δὲ τὴν εὐχὴν τῆς ς΄ Ὥρας, Ἀπόλυσις.
    Τῇ αὐτῇ Τετάρτῃ ἑσπέρας καὶ τῇ Πέμπτῃ πρωΐ, ἡ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς διετυπώθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 3-5.
    Τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀποδίδοται ἡ ἑορτή, ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Γ΄ § 18.

### ΙΓ΄.

37.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Παρασκευῇ τῆς Ε΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Τετάρτῃ πρωῒ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἱστῶμεν Στίχους ιστ΄, ἀρχόμενοι ἀπὸ τοῦ Στίχου Ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ ἐπορευόμην, καὶ ψάλλομεν τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τοῖς τῶν ἐμῶν λογισμῶν δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, εἶτα ἐκ τῶν κατ᾿ ἀλφάβητον Στιχηρῶν Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου ι΄, καὶ γ΄ Προεόρτια· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων.
    Τὸ ἑσπέρας ψάλλεται, μετ᾿ Ἀποδείπνου μικροῦ, ὁ Μέγας Κανών, ὡς εἴθισται, Κοντάκιον, μετὰ τὸ Τρισάγιον, Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου κτλ.

=== LEAF p480 ===

# Month of March: The Annunciation of the Theotokos (Situation XII § 36; Situation XIII Opening § 37)

## March 25: The Annunciation of Our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary (Situation XII § 36, Situation XIII § 37) [Violakis, p. 465]

### SITUATION TWELVE

36.    If the Feast occurs on Thursday of the Great Canon: on Tuesday morning at Vespers, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Prosomia of the order of the Triodion, and the 3 Forefeast Prosomia; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Readings of the day [Genesis 15:1–15; Proverbs 15:7–19]. The 2 Idiomela of the Aposticha, the Martyrikon, and the Alphabetical Stichira: **"All my life"** (*Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου*), with the Verse: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"; then the Trisagion Prayers, **"Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*), **"Lord, have mercy"** (40 times), **"O Heavenly King"** (*Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ*), the three Great Prostrations (here the Prayer of Saint Ephraim is understood), the Prayer: **"All-Holy Trinity"** (*Παναγία Τριάς*), **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.
    In the evening of that day [Tuesday], the Great Canon is celebrated with Small Compline, as is customary; following the Trisagion Prayers, the Kontakion: **"My soul, my soul"** (*Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου*), etc., and Dismissal.
    On Wednesday morning, Matins of the Paramony and the Hours are celebrated as prescribed in Situation One, § 2; after the Prayer of the 6th Hour, Dismissal.
    On that Wednesday evening and Thursday morning, the Office of the Feast is chanted as prescribed in Situation One, §§ 3–5.
    The Apodosis of the Feast takes place that evening, as prescribed in Situation Three, § 18.

### SITUATION THIRTEEN

37.    If the Feast occurs on Friday of the 5th Week: on Wednesday morning at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we insert 16 verses beginning from the verse: **"In the way wherein I walked"** (*Ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ ἐπορευόμην*, Ps. 141:4 LXX), and we chant the Idiomelon: **"To the movements of my thoughts"** (*Τοῖς τῶν ἐμῶν λογισμῶν*) twice, and the Martyrikon once; then 10 of the Alphabetical Stichira: **"All my life"** (*Ἅπας ὁ βίος μου*), and 3 of the Forefeast; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Gabriel announces"** (*Εὐαγγελίζεται ὁ Γαβριήλ*). Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Readings of the Triodion [Genesis 17:1–9; Proverbs 15:20 – 16:9], **"Let my prayer arise"** (*Κατευθυνθήτω*, Ps. 140:2 LXX), and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts follows in order.
    In the evening, the Great Canon is chanted with Small Compline, as is customary; after the Trisagion Prayers, the Kontakion: **"My soul, my soul"** (*Ψυχή μου, ψυχή μου*), etc.[^299]
